svg.aria-label: The twenty residues lining the CDK9 ATP site, and the structurally equivalent residue in CDK7, CDK12 and CDK13
svg.title: The pocket, residue by residue
svg.text: Twenty residues line the CDK9 site within 5 Å of flavopiridol. Selectivity is decided here, not across the domain.
Equivalence across targets is by structural superposition, nearest Cα after CEalign — not by sequence alignment.
distance to the nearest ligand atom
Cys106 sits at the hinge. The other three have Met.
CDK9 Asp104-Phe105-Cys106-Glu107. CDK7 has Met94, CDK12 Met816, CDK13 Met794.
Cys106 is 3.2 Å from flavopiridol. It is the only position in the twenty where CDK9 differs
from all three counter-targets and sits directly on the ligand.
This came out of the sequence pass as a guess. The structures confirm it.
Ala153 is the other one, on the floor: Asn in CDK7, Ser in CDK12 and CDK13.
Coloured and bold where the counter-target differs from CDK9. Shaded columns are the two positions where CDK9 differs from all three.
An asterisk means the nearest Cα after superposition is more than 2.5 Å away, so read that one as approximate. CDK7 is the worst case at 3.9 Å RMSD, which is what a 3.0 Å structure buys you.
